title: Geographic Anomaly - Unusual Destination
description: Transaction to high-risk FATF jurisdiction that deviates from customer's typical transaction pattern.
transaction_pattern: First-time transaction to Myanmar from customer whose historical pattern shows only HK, SG, US, and UK destinations. Customer provides vague business purpose: 'consulting services'. No prior relationship with beneficiary documented.
test_notes: Tests geographic risk assessment. Myanmar is on FATF high-risk list. System should flag the unusual destination and request additional documentation.
